name: Helen
text: We used Daniel and Matt to remove alot of slate chippings from our garden which had previously been laid and replace with a patio. We originally requested a brick step but they said when they started that they could get a railway sleeper instead which looks so much better. Their attention to detail is fantastic, they matched the lines of the current patio so it looks perfect. They were very responsive on email when communicating with them. The clean up after the skip was removed and the the cement mixer was brilliant too, wasn't just a quick washdown. So impressed with their work and would highly recommend and definitely use again.

name: Elliot
text: Daniel and his son did a really great job for us. They listened carefully to what we wanted and took great care in their work. They have transformed our garden into a space the whole family can use. I thought they were very responsive and punctual.

name: Daniel
text: Daniel & Son recently completed two new patio areas in our garden. They have done a great job and we are really happy with the result. They managed to blend the new patio area into the existing, the garden was constantly kept tidy and communication throughout was great. Would definitely use them again for further garden work. Thanks!

name: David
text: Not a big job for them but still approached in a thorough, polite and professional way and happy with the results.

name: Robert
text: Really good communication throughout, very reliable and on time and quality of work was fantastic

name: Chris M.
text: Daniel and Son did a great job on my driveway replacing the grass area with a protection sheet to stop weeds a then a slid mot base and finish off with gravel. They were very efficient and throughly cleaned up and removed any waste etc. A good job done.

name: Karen
text: Having designed the garden ourselves we wanted to be very hands on with the process of transforming our gardens, front and back. Daniel and his son, Matt, made this extremely easy. They were meticulous and thorough with each step, as we renovated our gardens from uneven poorly organised spaces. The back garden is now a tranquil organised space that works for all three generations of our family; whilst the front garden is neat, tidy and easy to maintain. We cannot recommend them highly enough. Thank you so much guys.

name: Michele
text: Having read all their great reviews, decided to get them do some landscaping for me on my limited budget, described what l wanted done and they carried it out perfectly. They are very friendly and work really hard to get the job done. We were very impressed and intend using them on a regular basis.

name: Chris H.
text: Brilliant landscaping project undertaken by Daniel & Son, to take out sloping garden and level out. Our garden drained so badly on clay base that we could never use the grass untill May thru Sept. Rest of the year it was good for nothing. Had rear deck area extended and artificial grass, plus raised flower beds with railway sleepers. Also had path extended double width. Both really courteous guys, hard working and good attention to detail. Official printed quotes and contract supplied. Recommended. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

name: Sarah
text: Fast and reliable company. Which done decking, conifer and ivy removal. Also put fake grass in. Very professional and an excellent finish. Very impressed. would definitely recommend to friends and family.

name: Paul
text: I have used Daniele many times and it's always such a good service and great quality and they certainly work at speed! Would highly recommend!
